description:
Running 'cargo clippy --workspace --tests -- -D warnings' from the workspace root fails on jmap-jscontact-types because of a clippy::type-complexity error at crate-jmap-jscontact-types/src/lib.rs:1735:

  let cases: &[(&str, serde_json::Value, fn(&AnniversaryDate) -> bool)] = &[

This blocks the AGENTS.md-mandated pre-commit workspace clippy gate. Fix options:

1. Introduce a type alias above the test, e.g.:
   type AnniversaryCase = (&'static str, serde_json::Value, fn(&AnniversaryDate) -> bool);
   let cases: &[AnniversaryCase] = &[ ... ];

2. Or apply #[allow(clippy::type_complexity)] on the function — discouraged; alias is more idiomatic.

Confirmed pre-existing on HEAD c436820 — not caused by JMAP-510h.14.1 (test-migration of filenode-server). Surfaced while running the workspace clippy gate after that change.

Scope: jmap-jscontact-types only; one site.
title: jscontact-types: cargo clippy --tests fails with type-complexity at lib.rs:1735
